children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) -
Aurania Resources Ltd.
(OTCQB: AUIAF) (FSE: 20Q) ("Aurania" or the "Company")

announces that it has (i) terminated its previously announced private placement, (ii) entered into a loan agreement with its Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, Dr. Keith Barron, and (iii) intends to extend the term of certain outstanding common share purchase warrants.
The Company has terminated its non-brokered private placement as announced by the Company on
, due to current market conditions.
Dr. Keith Barron has agreed to provide a loan of up to US$1,500,000 to the Company to be advanced from time to time in principal amounts as agreed by the parties (the "
Loan

"). The Loan is unsecured, bears interest at 2% per annum and matures twelve months and one day after demand for repayment is given by the Lender, which may be provided at any time following the date hereof. The proceeds of the Loan will be used for exploration expenses and general working capital.

Dr. Keith Barron is a related party of the Company by virtue of the fact that he is Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, a promoter and a principal shareholder of the Company, and as a result, each advance and repayment under the Loan constitutes a "
Related Party Transaction
" for the purposes of Multilateral Instrument 61-101 -
Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions

"). The Company is relying upon an exemption from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements under MI 61-101 in respect of the Related Party Transaction, in reliance on Sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1) of MI 61-101, respectively, as the fair market value of the Related Party Transaction, collectively, does not exceed 25% of the Company's market capitalization, as determined in accordance with MI 61-101. The Company did not file a material change report related to the Loan more than 21 days before the expected closing of the Loan as required by MI 61-101, as the Company wished to organize the Loan on an expedited basis for sound business reasons.
The Company further announces that it has applied to the TSX Venture Exchange (the "
TSXV
") to extend the expiry date of an aggregate of 3,747,243 common share purchase warrants of the Company (the "
Warrants
") issued pursuant to a non-brokered private placement of the Company (the "
Offering
"), which closed in tranches on
, and

. Each Warrant is exercisable at a price of C$0.75, with 2,726,499 Warrants expiring on December 13, 2026, and 1,020,744 Warrants expiring on December 23, 2026. The Company intends to extend the expiry date for these Warrants by 12 months to December 13, 2027, and December 23, 2027, respectively for each tranche of Warrants. All other terms and conditions of the Warrants will remain unchanged. The extension of the expiry date of the Warrants is subject to the acceptance of the TSXV.

Dr. Keith Barron participated in the Offering (subscribing through Bambazonke Holdings Ltd., a wholly-owned company of Dr. Barron) and accordingly was issued 888,889 of the Warrants, all of which Dr. Barron continues to hold (the "
Insider Warrants

"). Dr. Barron's ownership of the Insider Warrants renders the Warrant expiry date extension a "related party transaction" within the meaning of MI 61-101. However, the extension is exempt from the requirements of Part 5 of MI 61-101 pursuant to Sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1) of MI 61-101 as the fair market value of Dr. Keith Barron's interest in the extension does not exceed 25% of the Company's market capitalization, as determined in accordance with MI 61-101.

The Loan and the Warrant extension were approved by the members of the board of directors of the Company who are independent for purposes of the related party transactions, being all directors other than Dr. Barron. No special committee was established in connection with the Loan or Warrant extension, and no materially contrary view or abstention was expressed or made by any director of the Company in relation thereto.
About Aurania

Aurania is a mineral exploration company engaged in the identification, evaluation, acquisition, and exploration of mineral property interests, with a focus on precious metals and critical energy in Europe and abroad.

Information on Aurania and technical reports are available at www.aurania.com and www.sedarplus.ca, as well as on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/auranialtd/, Twitter at https://twitter.com/auranialtd, and LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/company/aurania-resources-ltd-.
